title: Four Northwoods towns unite to rebuild EMS — and cut response times in half
summary_en: With support from UW–Madison’s Wisconsin Office of Rural Health, Vilas County communities replaced a strained volunteer system with a 24/7 paramedic service.

title: Universities of Wisconsin to host public listening sessions for presidential search
summary_en: UW–Madison will serves as a listening session site on Wednesday, June 10. Students, faculty, staff and community members are invited to attend in personal or virtually.
title_cn: Universities of Wisconsin to host public listening sessions for presidential search

title: The two Owens
summary_en: The death of a six-year-old inspired a UW–Madison researcher to investigate a rare brain cancer.

title: Research at UW–Madison improves care for dogs undergoing surgeries
summary_en: A 2023 study led to an anesthesia method to keep dogs comfortable and healthy when undergoing many surgical procedures necessary for their care.
title_cn: Research at UW–Madison improves care for dogs undergoing surgeries
